description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure from the paper. It is a square publisher-interface badge (~256 x 256 px, low resolution) with a pale grey gradient background and a thin grey rounded border. Centred on it is the Crossref-style "Check for updates" logo: a circular arrow made of two thick arc segments — a blue-teal segment occupying the upper right/upper left and a yellow segment occupying the lower left/lower right — which encircles a solid red vertical ribbon/bookmark shape whose bottom edge is notched into a shallow inverted "V". Below the circular emblem are two lines of dark grey sans-serif text reading "Check for updates" (lower-case "for"). There are no axes, no units, no tick marks, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no curves, no micrograph, and no numeric values of any kind. The image carries no information about steel composition, microstructure, density or mechanical properties, and no caption was extracted for it, so nothing ties it to the Fe–Mn–Al–C low-density steel study. It appears to be an automatically harvested graphical element (journal watermark/badge) rather than an authored figure, and should not be interpreted as data.
